correctness.rationale: Every vertex of a biclique side sees the same neighboring count; the exact binomial kernel and disjoint even-time noise support independent side limits. Side tie restarts have probability BD<=1/4, yielding exact solutions u*=(C+DA)/(1-BD) and v*=(A+BC)/(1-BD), almost-sure classification, geometric hitting bound E[T]<=22/3 and the Gaussian critical window. Exact-rational absorbing-chain computations independently verify all 980 count states in 80 chain instances and central tie bound samples; these finite checks corroborate, not prove, the analytic quantifiers.

value.rationale: A nontrivial exact classification for all biclique sizes, both community tie probabilities and fixed initial colorings, including the only three recurrent classes; a uniform expected hitting bound; and a sharp two-bias polarization transition with Gaussian scaling. The complete-bipartite network is a natural two-community social model and contrasts structurally with the general-graph exponential transient in the source.
